lines.zh: 我的脚陷进泥里又拔出来。
lines.en: My foot sinks into mud and comes out again.
The swamp water only reaches my knees.
I wade through duckweed and rotten logs.
Mud has caked on my trouser legs.
I move faster here than on dry land.

lines.zh: 水草缠了一下我的脚踝。
lines.en: Weeds snag once around my ankle.
I burst a string of bubbles underfoot.
I walk toward the sound of frogs.

lines.zh: 我的脚印里慢慢积满黑水。
lines.en: Black water slowly fills my footprints.
Reeds brush against my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我从倒下的树干下钻过。
lines.en: I duck beneath a fallen trunk.
I haul my mud-soaked body ashore.
I stand motionless in the shallows.

lines.zh: 有蚊子落在我的手臂上。
lines.en: Mosquitoes settle on my arm.
I listen to the swamp bubbling.
The poison in my mouth has not faded.
A leech has crawled into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是怎么沉下去的。
lines.en: I remember how I sank.

lines.zh: 我把手伸进水里又抬起。
lines.en: I dip my hand in the water and lift it.
A frog lands on my knee.
I wait for the water to go still again.
My skin has soaked pale.

lines.zh: 你的火把离水面太近了。
lines.en: Your torch is too close to the water.
I know the warmth of the living.
Will your nose find me?
I stare at your eyes; do not blink.
The mud on your boots is fresh.

lines.zh: 你也在沼泽里迷路了吧。
lines.en: You are lost in the swamp too, yes?
You are standing in my path.
Your breathing is so steady.

lines.zh: 我很久没见过明白的眼睛。
lines.en: I have not seen clear eyes in a long while.
You will enjoy the damp here.

lines.zh: 我的手臂被你砍开一道口子。
lines.en: You opened a gash along my arm.
Green water runs from the wound.
It hurts, but I am used to it.
You knocked off a piece of my rotten flesh.

lines.zh: 幼体自爆时也是这样响。
lines.en: A young one's blast sounds much like this.
My chest has been caved in.

lines.zh: 痛感顺着脊椎爬到指尖。
lines.en: The ache crawls down my spine to my fingertips.
Knocked back, my feet sink deeper.
The wound is bubbling; do not touch it.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙把身子转回来。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and turn back around.

lines.zh: 我不吃给的东西，我自己找。
lines.en: I take no gifts; I find my own.
Holding the bread high will not help.
I only want to drag you into the mud.
I can pick up rotten flesh myself.

lines.zh: 食物对我已经没有味道。
lines.en: Food has lost its taste for me.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我咬不动。
lines.en: I cannot bite what you are holding.

lines.zh: 诱惑一具死尸没什么用。
lines.en: Tempting a corpse is a waste.
I prefer what the mud gives me.
Keep it and eat it yourself.
My appetite opens only for the living.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，泥甩你一脸。
lines.en: One shove and mud flies in your face.

lines.zh: 我的肩膀湿滑，你抓不住。
lines.en: My shoulder is slick; you cannot hold it.
You step into the pit beside me.

lines.zh: 我撞得你后退，水里站不稳。
lines.en: I knock you back; the water gives no footing.

lines.zh: 我们身上都是泥，分不清。
lines.en: We are both mud; who can tell us apart?

lines.zh: 我感觉到你的骨头在震。
lines.en: I feel your bones jar.
The water ripples outward from the impact.
Stepping aside would sink me deeper.
You shove me and I only sway.
My hide is wet and cold.

lines.zh: 沼泽里没有谁愿意靠近我。
lines.en: No one in this swamp comes near me.
Even my own kind avoid my smell.

lines.zh: 我早就忘了怎么靠近别人。
lines.en: I have long forgotten how to come close.
There is only me in this mud.
This body was not made for holding.

lines.zh: 我不需要伴，只需要猎物。
lines.en: I need no mate, only prey.

lines.zh: 你留下，我就把你变成同伴。
lines.en: Stay, and I will make you one of us.

lines.zh: 我的新娘会是这片沼泽。
lines.en: This swamp will be my bride.
The other zombies have wandered off.
I keep this pool alone.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块泡烂的木板。
lines.en: I pick up a waterlogged plank.

lines.zh: 这个瓶子里的东西我留着。
lines.en: I keep what is in this bottle.

lines.zh: 我捡起一把生锈的匕首。
lines.en: I pick up a rusted dagger.
Whatever lies in the mud is mine.

lines.zh: 我把骨头塞进泥里藏着。
lines.en: I push the bone into the mud to hide it.
I fish a torn cloth off the water.

lines.zh: 我拾起一颗滑腻的石子。
lines.en: I pick up a slippery stone.
This coin is slick with black water.

lines.zh: 我抓住一只挣扎的青蛙。
lines.en: I catch a struggling frog.
What falls here always sinks.
Water splashes beyond the reeds.
I hear someone coughing.
The ripples run against the wind.

lines.zh: 有火光照到了我的树根。
lines.en: Torchlight reaches my roots.
I smell sweat and iron.
Something moves in the mud.
I walk toward that line of bubbles.
Someone made a plank creak.
My fingertips begin to twitch.
I hear grass being pushed aside.
That lantern is too bright to hide.
These steps have a familiar weight.
Something living has stopped by the water.
The swamp passed me the news.

lines.zh: 浮萍往两边让开，是我在过来。
lines.en: The duckweed parts to both sides. That is me arriving.
I crouch low, ready to leap.
The water at your feet is shallow.
I wait for you to take one more step.
Your back is to the black water.

lines.zh: 我半蹲在泥里，等你过来。
lines.en: I crouch in the mud, waiting for you to come.
When you stop, I move.
My knees bend even lower.
You have looked away from me.

lines.zh: 泥会拖慢你，不会拖慢我。
lines.en: Mud slows you, not me.
Back to the water, you have no path.
The ground beneath me is firm.
I fix on your throat.
The bubbles at your feet are poison.
I wait one more breath.

lines.zh: 我把膝盖弯得更低，脚尖对着泥。
lines.en: I bend my knees lower, toes pointed at the mud.

lines.zh: 你脚下的泥，我已经踩过一遍。
lines.en: I have already walked the mud under your feet.
The water is moving. You don't hear it.
I wait for you to step into that soft mud.

lines.zh: 我扑过去，把你按进泥里。
lines.en: I leap and drive you into the mud.

lines.zh: 我的指甲刮过你的手腕。
lines.en: My nails rake across your wrist.
Your eyes will fail first.

lines.zh: 毒从我的牙缝里渗出来。
lines.en: Poison seeps between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我这一跃甩了你一身泥。
lines.en: My leap splashes mud all over you.
You inhale, and the poison goes with it.
I grab your collar and drag you to the water.
Your skin is going numb, is it not?
The swamp will keep you for me.

lines.zh: 我的舌头贴上你的脖子。
lines.en: My tongue presses to your neck.
You hit me, yet I stay on top of you.

lines.zh: 我闻到你眼睛里的血味。
lines.en: I smell the blood behind your eyes.

lines.zh: 你踉跄一步，正好在泥坑边。
lines.en: You stumble, right at the mud pit's edge.
This bite makes you cough green froth.

lines.zh: 我抓你的脸，指甲里全是泥。
lines.en: I claw your face, mud under my nails.

lines.zh: 你咳的时候，我又凑近了一步。
lines.en: When you cough, I lean in one step more.
I float up from the bottom of the mud.

lines.zh: 沼泽今晚给了我一副新身体。
lines.en: The swamp gave me a new body tonight.

lines.zh: 气泡从我领口一粒粒冒出。
lines.en: Bubbles rise one by one from my collar.

lines.zh: 我从腐烂的树根间站起。
lines.en: I rise among the rotting roots.
The water moves first, then I do.
My first sound is a gurgle.
Rain fell on the swamp, and I woke.

lines.zh: 我带着水底的臭味出现。
lines.en: I appear trailing the stench of the bottom.
I will empty these shallows.

lines.zh: 我从水草最密的地方起来。
lines.en: I come up where the weeds grow thickest.
The fog is thick; you should see me clearly.
I touched the bank and stood.
The swamp gave me a push.
My feet have found solid ground at last.

lines.zh: 火燎着我，皮肤开始收缩。
lines.en: Flames lick me and my skin tightens.

lines.zh: 落地的冲击让我吐出一口泥。
lines.en: The impact knocks a mouthful of mud out of me.

lines.zh: 水灌满我，我沉进毒泥里。
lines.en: Water fills me and I sink into the poison mud.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我撕成绿色的碎块。
lines.en: The blast tears me into green pieces.
The arrow stays in my shoulder; I leave it.

lines.zh: 魔法灼烧我，臭味更浓了。
lines.en: Magic burns me and the stench thickens.

lines.zh: 我不怕饿，只是变得更干。
lines.en: I do not fear hunger; I only dry out.
The lightning showed me as bare bone.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有泥可以张开。
lines.en: The void has no mud to burst open.
